name: Shoe lifts / elevator shoes
summary: Instant +2–3cm (inserts) to +7cm (elevator shoes) while worn.
lead: Shoe lifts are inserts that raise the heel inside a shoe, and elevator shoes are footwear with a thickened insole or hidden lift that makes the wearer appear taller. Unlike visibly high-heeled shoes, the height-adding component is concealed inside the shoe. Lifts may be made of plastic, rubber, wood or silicone.

name: Self-tanning mousse
summary: DHA color without a single UV photon. Lasts about a week.
lead: Self-tanning mousse is a foam-format sunless tanning product, usually applied with a mitt, that colours the skin through a sugar-derived color additive called dihydroxyacetone (DHA). Other sunless tanners come as lotions, gels, sprays, wipes and drops.

name: Self-tanning drops
summary: Mix into moisturizer, dial in the depth.
lead: Self-tanning drops are concentrated dihydroxyacetone (DHA) preparations that users mix into a moisturizer, lotion or face cream, so that the number of drops determines how deep the resulting colour is. They are especially discussed for face tanning, where a gradual, adjustable colour is wanted.

name: Tanning mitt
summary: The difference between a tan and orange palms.
lead: A tanning mitt is a thin glove, typically velvet-like on the outside and sometimes lined with latex or another barrier on the inside, used to spread self-tanning product across the skin and keep the user's hands from being coloured. It is a common accessory for applying sunless tanner, particularly to avoid stained palms.

name: Tinted facial SPF
summary: UV protection + tone correction daily. The highest-ROI skincare purchase, full stop.
lead: Tinted facial SPF is a sunscreen for the face that contains pigments, usually iron oxides and pigment-grade titanium dioxide, which give light coverage and even out skin tone. Many are mineral or hybrid formulas and are sold in a range of shades.
claims: Tinted sunscreen can cover acne and even out skin tone in a single step.
Tinted sunscreen may temporarily improve dark circles under the eyes.
A tint adds protection that regular sunscreen lacks.
Between two shades, one should choose a lighter or a darker tint.

name: Broad-spectrum sunscreen
summary: The #1 proven anti-aging product on earth. Everything else is a rounding error.
lead: Broad-spectrum sunscreen is a topical product containing filters that protect against both ultraviolet B (UVB) and ultraviolet A (UVA) radiation. It comes as lotions, gels, sticks and sprays, and its filters are classed as chemical (organic, absorbing UV and releasing it as heat), mineral (zinc oxide and titanium dioxide) or hybrid.
claims: Daily sunscreen is the most cost-efficient anti-aging measure and slows skin aging.
Most skin aging, roughly 90 percent, is caused by the sun.
Sunscreen chemicals are toxic, so hats are preferable.
Mineral sunscreens leave a white cast or darken the skin, and European or Asian filters are better.

name: UV-protective sunglasses
summary: Protects the eye area — where wrinkles show first. Also squinting causes crow’s feet.
lead: UV-protective sunglasses are tinted eyewear whose lenses are intended to absorb or block ultraviolet (UV) radiation as well as reduce visible glare. Labels commonly describe such lenses as blocking 99 to 100 percent of UVA and UVB rays, or use the term "UV400"; U.S. and international standards are cited as the basis for this labelling .

name: UV tanning bed
summary: Yes, it tans you.
lead: A UV tanning bed, also called a sunbed or solarium, is a device with lamps that emit ultraviolet (UV) radiation, mostly UVA with a small amount of UVB, to produce a cosmetic tan. Horizontal beds are the most common type; stand-up versions are called tanning booths. They are found in salons, gyms, spas and hotels and, less often, in private homes .
claims: Sunbed tanning improves a man's looks, at least in the short term.
Going out in the sun is a better option than a sunbed.
A tan is essential to looking good, so regular sunbed sessions are worth resuming.

name: Glass nail file + buffer
summary: Clean, shaped nails. People notice hands more than you think.
lead: A glass nail file is a reusable nail file whose abrasive surface is made of glass, usually tempered Bohemian-style glass with a fine grit produced by chemical etching. It is used to shape and smooth the free edge of fingernails and toenails, often after trimming with clippers . A buffer is a separate block or strip, often multi-sided, used to smooth ridges and add shine to the nail plate .

name: Cuticle oil pen
summary: Conditioned cuticles finish the look.
lead: A cuticle oil pen is a twist-up or click-style applicator containing a blend of plant oils, often including jojoba, almond or vitamin E, which is brushed onto the skin around the base of the nails. It is marketed for softening the nail-fold skin and the thin band of tissue at the nail base so that it looks less dry, cracked or ragged.

name: Electric foot file
summary: Smooth heels in minutes.
lead: An electric foot file is a handheld, battery-powered or mains-powered device with a rotating abrasive roller or disc, used to remove calluses and rough skin from the heels and soles. It mechanises the work of a pumice stone or manual foot rasp and is usually used on dry skin.

name: Korean exfoliating mitt
summary: Aggressive, satisfying full-body exfoliation.
lead: The Korean exfoliating mitt, also sold as an Italy towel or kessa-style mitt, is a coarse viscose or nylon glove used to scrub the body, typically after soaking in warm water or a bath. The scrubbing produces visible rolls of loosened dead skin and is associated with Korean bathhouse bathing culture.

name: Dry brush
summary: Fine exfoliation. The lymph-drainage claims are marketing.
lead: Dry brushing, also called dry skin brushing or garshana, is the practice of stroking a stiff, natural-bristle brush over dry skin, usually before a shower, in long strokes directed toward the heart. Grokipedia, an AI-generated encyclopedia, links it to Ayurvedic tradition and to a Japanese practice of dry towel friction .

name: Silicone scar tape
summary: Flattens some raised scars over months of wear.
lead: Silicone scar tape, also called silicone gel sheeting, is a thin, adhesive silicone sheet worn over a healing or healed scar. It is used mainly for raised hypertrophic and keloid scars and is sold over the counter for surgical and other scars. Treatment typically involves wearing the sheet for many hours a day over a period of months.

name: Blackout curtains
summary: Deep sleep is when skin repairs and hormones reset. Darkness is step one.
lead: Blackout curtains are window coverings made from, or lined with, an opaque fabric that blocks most outside light from entering a room. The term blackout refers to a foam-backed opaque fabric most often seen as hotel curtain lining or drapery . They are popular with people who sleep during the day, with parents of infants, and with residents of areas with heavy night-time light pollution .

name: Sleep mask
summary: Blackout curtains for your face.
lead: A sleep mask, also called an eyeshade or sleeping blindfold, is a covering worn over the eyes to keep light out and make it easier to fall and stay asleep . Wikipedia lists use as a sleep aid, especially during air travel and for people who sleep by day, among the applications of blindfolds generally .

name: Humidifier
summary: Dry indoor air dries skin. Especially in winter.
lead: A humidifier is an appliance that adds water vapour or fine droplets to indoor air to raise its relative humidity. Point-of-use models serve a single room, such as a bedroom, while whole-house units connect to a building's heating system . Humidifiers are also built into some medical ventilators for patient comfort .

name: White noise machine
summary: Fewer wake-ups in noisy environments.
lead: A white noise machine is a device that plays a steady, broadband sound intended to calm the listener or mask other noise. Despite the name, many such devices produce pink noise, whose power falls off at higher frequencies, or other noise colours or nature-like sounds, because true white noise sounds harsh . They are used as sleep aids, for power-napping, for sound masking and privacy, and by some people with tinnitus .

name: Cooling eye mask
summary: Morning depuff in 10 minutes.
lead: A cooling eye mask is a gel pad, gel-filled packet or similar pack that is chilled, usually in a refrigerator or freezer, and placed over the closed eyes. In appearance-focused communities it is used mainly in the morning with the aim of reducing temporary puffiness around the eyes over several minutes.

name: Nasal dilator / strips
summary: Better nasal airflow for some sleepers. Airflow — not jaw development.
lead: Nasal dilators are devices that hold the nostrils or nasal valve open to ease airflow. External dilator strips are adhesive bandages with embedded plastic ribs or splints, applied across the bridge and sides of the nose, while internal dilators are inserted into the nostrils . They are sold over the counter and used for nasal congestion, snoring, sleep and exercise .

name: Sunrise alarm clock
summary: Consistent wake time → consistent sleep → better face.
lead: A sunrise alarm clock, also called a wake-up light or dawn simulator, is a bedside lamp that brightens gradually over roughly 30 minutes to 2 hours before a set wake time to imitate dawn, and often adds an optional sound alarm and a dimming dusk mode for bedtime . Because light passes through closed eyelids, the sleeper is exposed to rising illumination before waking .

name: Anti-wrinkle pillow
summary: The sleep-compression theory is plausible; the product evidence is weak. Back-sleeping is free.
lead: Anti-wrinkle pillows are contoured, cut-out or cushioned pillows, and pillowcase-style products, marketed to reduce pressure and creasing of the face against the bedding during sleep. The premise is that repeated compression of the same facial areas, particularly in side and stomach sleepers, contributes to sleep lines on the forehead, cheeks and chest. Related products use silk, satin or metal-infused covers aimed at reducing friction.

name: Tailoring (any clothes)
summary: The biggest instant upgrade per dollar in existence. Fit beats brand every time.
lead: Tailoring, in the sense used in style and grooming discussions, is the practice of having a tailor alter ready-made clothing so that it follows the wearer's measurements, for example by hemming trousers, taking in a shirt or shortening sleeves. A tailor is a person who makes or alters clothing, particularly men's clothing, and the English term is dated by the Oxford English Dictionary to the thirteenth century. A more extensive service, often called bespoke or made-to-measure, constructs a garment from scratch using custom patterns and several fittings, whereas alterations are smaller adjustments to existing garments that are generally quicker and cheaper.

name: Clothes steamer
summary: Wrinkled shirt = unmade bed. 90 seconds fixes it.
lead: A clothes steamer, also called a garment steamer, is an appliance that heats water and releases the resulting steam onto fabric to remove wrinkles. According to Wikipedia, the steam relaxes tension in the fibres so that the cloth straightens itself, and steamers can also reduce odours. Unlike an iron, which presses fabric against a flat surface, a steamer is usually used on hanging garments and is described as gentler on delicate cloth such as silk.

name: Fabric shaver
summary: De-pills sweaters back to new.
lead: A fabric shaver, also called a lint shaver or fuzz remover, is a handheld electric device with a rotating blade beneath a protective net. It trims pills and fuzz from fabric without cutting the cloth itself, and is used mostly on knitwear such as sweaters, hoodies and wool, angora or cashmere garments, as well as on bedding, curtains and carpets. Models are powered by dry-cell batteries or an internal rechargeable battery.

name: Compression undershirt
summary: Smoother torso silhouette under fitted clothes, instantly.
lead: A compression undershirt is a close-fitting elastic top worn beneath other clothing. In appearance discussions it is used to give the torso a smoother, firmer outline under fitted shirts. It belongs to the broader family of compression garments, which Grokipedia describes as elastic clothing engineered to apply mechanical pressure to the body, with medical, athletic and cosmetic variants, the last including shapewear and girdles.

name: Collar stays
summary: Crisp collars frame the face.
lead: A collar stay is a smooth strip of rigid material, rounded at one end and pointed at the other, that slides into a pocket on the underside of a dress-shirt collar to keep the collar points stable. Wikipedia says the stays help the collar lie flat against the collarbone and stay crisp and correctly placed. They go by several names, including collar stiffener, collar stick and, in British English, collar bone or collar tab.

name: Shoe trees + polish kit
summary: People read shoes. Keep them sharp.
lead: Shoe trees are foot-shaped devices placed inside shoes to preserve their shape, limit creasing and extend the life of the shoe. Wikipedia adds that they also help draw out moisture from sweat, which it describes as a cause of lining rot and leather degradation, and that higher-quality trees are made from cedar or other softwood that helps control odour. A polish kit pairs brushes, cream and wax to clean, condition and shine leather shoes.

name: Good sunglasses
summary: Reframes facial proportions instantly — pick the shape that balances yours.
lead: Sunglasses are tinted or darkened eyewear designed mainly to reduce glare and protect the eyes from bright light, including ultraviolet radiation. They have also been a popular fashion accessory since the 1930s. In appearance advice, a well-chosen pair is said to change how the face reads, with frame shape and width used to balance facial proportions, and the wiki's summary describes frames as reframing proportions.
claims: Sunglasses are a cheap substitute for eye-area surgery and hide flaws such as bad canthal tilt or recessed orbitals.
Specific frame shapes balance facial proportions depending on face shape.
People with long midfaces, bug eyes or wide noses look noticeably better in sunglasses.

name: Bremelanotide
summary: PT-141 / Vyleesi, an Rx melanocortin peptide approved for low desire in premenopausal women and bought gray-market by some men; it has no studied role in looks, and pigment spotting is a known side effect.
lead: Bremelanotide, also known as PT-141 and marketed as Vyleesi, is a synthetic cyclic peptide analogue of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH) that acts as a melanocortin receptor agonist . It was first explored by Palatin Technologies for erectile dysfunction and later developed for women, and the US FDA approved it in 2019 for premenopausal women with acquired, generalized hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD) .
claims: PT-141 can raise libido and help when PDE5 inhibitors fail
Results are "hit and miss" and it is mainly for occasional use
PT-141 belongs to the same family as Melanotan II tanning peptides
Vials from peptide sites are a way to use PT-141 without a prescription
